cards.name: Beast - Snowfield Troublemaker
cards.cardText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they’re played.)
DYNAMIC MANEUVER Whenever this character challenges, if he’s at a location, he takes no damage from the challenge.

cards.name: Rapunzel - Ethereal Protector
cards.cardText:
Boost 2 {I} (Once during your turn, you may pay 2 {I} to put the top card of your deck facedown under this character.)
CLONK! Whenever this character quests, if there’s a card under her, chosen opposing character can’t challenge until the start of your next turn.

cards.name: Pocahontas - Guiding the Tribe
cards.cardText:
STAY CLOSE When you play this character, you may play a character with cost 1 for free.

“These vines are far from natural. They must end somewhere.”

cards.name: Vixey - Expert Fisher
cards.cardText:
STEALING IN When you play this character, if you have a character with Evasive in play, you may return chosen character, item, or location with cost 2 or less to their player’s hand.

“I’ve got my dinner. Where’s yours, Tod?”

cards.name: Buzz Lightyear - Providing Cover
cards.cardText:
ACTION FIGURE When you play this character, choose one of the following. If you have another Toy character in play, choose both instead:
• You may return an action card with cost 2 or less from your discard to your hand.
• You may play an action with cost 2 or less for free.

cards.name: Boo - Energetic Child
cards.cardText:
Rush (This character can challenge the turn they're played.)
KID-TASTROPHE! Whenever this character challenges another character with 3 {S} or less, banish that character. (No damage is dealt in that challenge.)

cards.name: Merlin - Envisioning the Future
cards.cardText:
MINOR TRICKERY When you play this character, you may draw a card from the bottom of your deck.
AGE OF INCONVENIENCE When this character is banished, put this card from your discard on the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Maximus - Relentless Stallion
cards.cardText: NO ESCAPE If you discarded a card this turn, this character gains Challenger +2 and can challenge ready characters this turn. (They get +2 {S} while challenging.)

cards.name: Nick Wilde - Inquisitive Harbormaster
cards.cardText:
Shift 4 {I} (You may pay 4 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Nick Wilde.)
RESTRICTED ROUTE Whenever this character quests, you may give chosen character Adventurous until the start of your next turn. (They can't challenge and must quest if able.)

cards.name: Merlin - Ink Drop Tinkerer
cards.cardText:
Shift 5 {I} (You may pay 5 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Merlin.)
WHAT A DISCOVERY! When you play this character, get 1 ink drop. If you used Shift to play him, get 2 ink drops instead. (Each ink drop may be removed to pay 1 {I}.)

cards.name: Above the Crowd
cards.cardText:
(A character with cost 5 or more can {E} to sing this song for free.) 
Put chosen opposing character with 3 {S} or less on the bottom of their player's deck.

cards.name: Goofy - Dancing Superstar
cards.cardText:
Shift 3 {I} (You may pay 3 {I} to play this on top of one of your characters named Goofy.)
Singer 6 (This character counts as cost 6 to sing songs.)
IN THE GROOVE Whenever this character quests, your other characters with Singer get +1 {L} this turn.

cards.name: Judy Hopps - Day Camp Instructor
cards.cardText:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
LEND A PAW When you play this character, if you played another character this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.

cards.name: Berlioz - Tiny Rascal
cards.cardText:
SHARP LITTLE CLAWS When you play this character, you may deal 1 damage to chosen character.

"This'll show that mean ol' butler."

cards.name: The Beanstalk - Onward and Upward
cards.cardText: THE DISTANT REACHES Characters get +1 {S} and gain Evasive while here. (Only characters with Evasive can challenge them.)
